project.styleDefinitionBrief: Native restrained reading experience, content-first black-white-gray hierarchy, real Chinese product copy, Songti SC only for reading body, Lucide 1.5px, hairlines and 4/8/16px radii.
project.designRead: Mobile reading and listening app / deep readers / native restraint / complete secondary flows and states / no card wall

sharedProjectShellContract.navigationShell: only now, shelf and profile contain the canonical three-tab flow-bottom navigation; all other boards use local navigation or reader/player chrome
sharedProjectShellContract.typographySystem: PingFang SC UI; Songti SC only for reading body; 400/600/700 weights
sharedProjectShellContract.radiusScale: 4px badges, 8px inputs and buttons, 16px sheets; pill only for segmented controls and true pill actions
sharedProjectShellContract.surfaceDepthModel: tokenized neutral surfaces and hairlines; static shadow alpha <= 0.05; stronger elevation only for sheets dialogs and menus
continuityAnchors: large native titles and clear section rhythm
black primary controls and neutral selected states
identical 64px three-tab navigation on primary pages

mobileNavigation.activeState: primary icon+label color only; geometry stays identical
